text: Researchers discuss topic quality and interpretable labels in the first monthly review.
The team compares training speed across traditional and neural topic models.
Users request clearer evidence for every recommendation and parameter choice.
Dataset privacy checks are reviewed before any samples enter the analysis workflow.
Analysts evaluate whether temporal changes indicate a stable shift in research themes.
A baseline model provides a reproducible comparison for later neural experiments.
Reviewers ask for confidence levels instead of unsupported precise runtime estimates.
The corpus includes enough documents to test a small deterministic recommendation run.
Hardware constraints favor moderate memory use and avoid unnecessary model downloads.
Topic granularity is adjusted after reviewers identify fragmented low-frequency themes.
The evidence index links model requirements to versioned configuration source lines.
Researchers compare topic prevalence between product feedback and technical reports.
A time column enables the workflow to consider dynamic topic modeling candidates.
Missing metadata prevents structural models from entering the compatible candidate set.
Every incompatible model records a machine-readable hard constraint reason code.
The first topic count run uses a bounded range rather than a pseudo-precise answer.
Batch size recommendations explain the tradeoff between memory and throughput.
Epoch recommendations describe runtime and overfitting effects for reviewers.
The workflow pauses before plan creation so the owner can inspect the proposal.
Training cannot start until a separate approval and dry-run have completed.
Replay reconstructs the recommendation decision from canonical runtime events.
A changed dataset hash invalidates confirmed columns and downstream approvals.
Raw document samples remain private while aggregate dataset observations are retained.
The local evidence index is refreshed only through an explicit operator command.
Repeated index builds skip unchanged sources by comparing deterministic content hashes.
Authority levels prioritize current model configuration over lower-trust notes.
No-evidence results remain visible and never produce fabricated source references.
The command line delegates state transitions to the compiled Hypha finite state machine.
Governed tools enforce permissions and schemas before invoking the Python bridge.
The final review confirms deterministic recommendations and a traceable event history.
